camel_example: aliyun drds EnableSqlAudit --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds00000000000 --DbName test
description_en: Enables the SQL audit feature by calling the EnableSqlAudit operation
description_zh: 调用EnableSqlAudit接口开启SQL审计功能
kebab_example: aliyun drds enable-sql-audit --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --db-name test --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableSqlAudit

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database for which to enable SQL audit
parameters.help_zh: 开启SQL审计的数据库名称。
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to recall historical SQL statements for auditing
parameters.help_zh: 是否回溯历史SQL进行审计
parameters.name: is_recall

parameters.help_en: The start time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 回溯开始时间，格式为时间戳（单位为毫秒）
parameters.name: recall_start_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the recall period. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
回溯结束时间，格式为时间戳（单位为毫秒）。
回溯结束时间需晚于开始时间
parameters.name: recall_end_timestamp

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the SQL audit feature is enabled
Result.description_zh: SQL审计功能是否开启成功
